title: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement

messages.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – ball bearing 6306-2Z C3, multi-year proposal
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for your offer for part:360020. Our expected volume is 20000 pieces per year. We propose a multi-year agreement of 24 months, as attached, to secure that volume for you under one framework. This matches your preference, stated in June, that only multi-year volume agreements change prices.

The forecast for part:360020 increased by 4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

The attached term sheets keep the payment terms of our current agreement ctr:4600070620. Could you tell us which package suits your planning best, and whether a cheaper variant is possible? Your owner kindly offered to walk us through your calculation; we would welcome that.

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – ball bearing 6306-2Z C3, multi-year proposal
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Thank you for your proposal and the updated volume forecast for a 24-month agreement. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. While we appreciate the longer-term commitment, our pricing is tightly bound to our current cost structures, limiting our flexibility. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

Our current proposal stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. As an alternative, we can offer €4.88 per unit for the 24-month contract with 30 days payment terms, and we would be glad to arrange a meeting to walk you through our calculation. This option reflects a price of €4.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.26 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.08 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.05 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Please note that this offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – part:360020, revised term sheets
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for your revised offer and for the invitation to walk us through your calculation. We would be glad to take that meeting.

We have moved our proposal and attach two packages. Both cover 20000 pieces per year over 24 months, one with 90 days and one with 30 days payment. The 24-month term gives you a fixed volume under one framework with less renewal work on both sides.

What is the lowest price at which you can sign these terms today?

If another payment term would ease your cash planning at a lower price, please let us know which one.

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – part:360020, revised term sheets
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing trust in Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide based on our quote, which includes a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Please note that our offer stays valid for 7 days.

We would be pleased to arrange a meeting to walk you through our calculation. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. To be transparent on our background: Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our margin and our limits stay internal. Furthermore, alternative payment terms do not allow for further price reductions, as our pricing is strictly bound to our cost structures. For your reference, our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.

We look forward to hearing from you soon!

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
